verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev ships an official CLI documented at cli-introduction with commands for local dev, self-hosting, and deployment (docs-16, docs-34, docs-35), corroborated by a probe confirming the docs page. This CLI is core to the developer/agentic workflow (deploy via GitHub Actions, etc.), though evidence doesn't show AI-native-specific CLI features (e.g., natural-language CLI commands) beyond standard dev tooling. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of CLI usage, and explicit AI-native CLI extensions beyond the general dev CLI.
